title: Eleven Inches of Glass and a Brass Grille
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：window　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 window 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: She stood at the same ① window for thirty-one years and never once sat down, and when they put a chair in, in 1989, she said it was not for her and moved it against the wall. The ② window, meaning the shop window on the street side, was dressed by somebody else every Thursday, and she never had an opinion about it and never once looked at it.

There were eleven people ahead of you at the ③ window on a Friday, and she knew nine of them by name and two by their business, and she said the second is the more useful of the two, and the window was never closed before four.

In 1994 they put a computer in, and she had to keep two ④ windows open at once, and she said a machine that asks you to look at two things at the same time is a machine that does not know what it wants, and the window stayed open all day.

There was a ⑤ window of about eleven weeks in 1979 in which the village could have kept the counter open on Saturdays, and nobody applied, and my mother says the whole village has complained about it ever since. In 1998 she was given a ⑥ window of two hours between the delivery and the collection, and she spent eleven of those minutes sitting down, which is the only time anybody ever saw it.

On the train to the county in 1974 she asked for a ⑦ window seat and then pulled the blind down, and my father said that was her whole character in one action. The ⑧ window display she was proudest of, and she did exactly one, was in 1961: eleven photographs of the street, with her own mother in four of them. The ⑨ window of the counter itself, which is what I think about, was eleven inches of glass and a brass grille: you spoke through it and could not see her mouth. The ⑩ window I remember is the one in the back room, which looked onto a wall, and which she opened every morning at seven for thirty-one years.

answers.why: the window 意为“（服务的）窗口、柜台窗口”，她在同一个窗口前站了三十一年，一次也没有坐下过。
the window ... shop window 意为“橱窗”，临街的橱窗每周四由别人布置，她从不发表意见，也从不看一眼。
the window 意为“柜台窗口”，周五那个窗口前总有十一个人排在你前面，她认得其中九个的名字。
windows 意为“（计算机屏幕上的）窗口、视窗”，1994 年装了电脑，她得同时开着两个窗口。
a window of ... 意为“（机会的）窗口、时机”，1979 年有一个约十一周的机会窗口，村里本可以申请周六也开门。
a window of two hours 意为“两小时的空档、间隙”，1998 年她在送货与收件之间有两小时的空档。
window seat 意为“靠窗座位”，1974 年去郡里的火车上她要了靠窗的座位，然后拉下了遮光帘。
window display 意为“橱窗陈列”，她一生只做过一次橱窗陈列，也是最得意的一次，在 1961 年。
the window of the counter 意为“柜台的那扇窗”，那是十一英寸的玻璃加一道铜栅栏，你隔着它说话，看不见她的嘴。
the window 意为“窗、窗户”，我记得的是后屋那扇窗，它朝着一堵墙，她三十一年里每天早上七点打开它。

answers: She stood at the same window for thirty-one years, and the shop window on the street side was dressed by somebody else every Thursday.
There were eleven people ahead of you at the window on a Friday, and the window was never closed before four.
